comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record peels protective film from a restrained acrylic sheet and bins it.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab insertion and tool-wire withdrawal versus bimanual hold-down, tab pinch, controlled peeling, and film disposal.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed without housing or neighbor damage versus film fully peeled while the sheet stays within motion/tilt limits and the tab remains attached.
comparison.reason: Generic pulling is shared, but peel-front control and substrate restraint are not latch release.
